I've been taking my dog ​​to the groomer for years. Every time I took her, they charged a different amount, always claiming it was for knots. They charged me €3 and a bit, and I already thought it was expensive. Today I took her and they charged me almost €43. The service was very good, but the prices are high. I think it's wrong that, knowing they've always charged me €32, €33, or at most €35, suddenly it's almost €43, and that they don't warn me beforehand so I can decide whether to bring her or not. Today it was because of the condition of my dog's coat, which means a quick shave is better than a scissor cut. Therefore, I'm no longer taking her; the price seems excessive.
Very happy, both with the way they treated me and my dog, and with the dog grooming services! A 10 out of 10!
